senses.gloss:
रभ् or रम्भ् (mostly comp. with a prep.; cf. √ ग्रभ् and See √ लभ् with which रभ् is connected) cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. xxiii, 5) र॑भते (mc. also ˚ति and ep. रम्भति, ˚ते; pf. रेभे॑, RV.; also रारभे and 1. pl. ररभ्मा॑; aor. अ॑रब्ध, RV.; fut. रब्धा Gr.; रप्स्यति, MBh.; ˚ते, ib. &c.; inf. रब्धुम्, MBh.; Ved. र॑भम्, र॑भे; ind.p. र॑भ्य, RV. &c.),
to take hold of, grasp, clasp, embrace, BhP. (अरभत्, Hariv. 8106 w.r. for आरभत्);
to desire vehemently, MW.;
to act rashly, ib. (cf. रभस्, रभस) :
Pass. रभ्यते aor. अरम्भि, Pāṇ. vii, 1, 63 :
Caus. रम्भयति, ˚ते aor. अररम्भत्, ib. :
Desid. रिप्सते, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 54 :
Intens. रारभ्यते, रारभीति, रारब्धि (as far as these forms really occur, they are only found after prepositions; cf. अन्व्-आ-, आ-, प्रा-, व्य्-आ-, परि-, सं-रभ् &c.)
रभ m. N. of a monkey, R.
र॑भस् n. violence, impetuosity, zeal, ardour, force, energy, RV.
र॑भसा (˚सा), ind. violently, impetuously, forcibly, roughly, MBh.; Pur.
रभस॑ mf(आ)n. (fr. prec.) impetuous, violent, rapid, fierce, wild, RV. &c. &c.
(ifc.) eager for, desirous of Kālid.
strong, powerful (said of the Soma), RV.
shining, glaring, ib.

रभस॑ m. impetuosity, vehemence, hurry, haste, speed, zeal, passion, eager desire for (comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c. (also f(आ). , L.; रभस ibc.; ˚आत् ind. and ˚एन ind. violently, impetuously, eagerly, quickly)
रभस॑ m. joy, pleasure, Gīt.
regret, sorrow, W.
poison, L.
N. of a magical incantation recited over weapons, R.
of a Dānava (v.l. रश्मिस)
of a king (son of Rambha), BhP.
of a Rākṣasa, L.
of a lexicographer (also called रभस-पाल), Cat.
of a monkey, R.
र॑भस्—वत् (र॑-भस्-), mfn. violent, impetuous, zealous, RV.
रभसात् ind., violently, impetuously, eagerly, quickly
रभसेन ind., violently, impetuously, eagerly, quickly
रभस—कोश m. Rabhasa's dictionary, Cat.
रभस—नन्दिन् m. N. of a Buddhist author, ib.
रभस—पाल m. N. of a lexicographer (cf. above), ib.
रभसान॑ mfn. shining, glaring, RV.
र॑भि f. a partic. part of a chariot, RV. (accord. to Sāy. ‘mfn. supporting’).
र॑भिष्ठ mf(आ)n. most violent or impetuous or strong, RV.; VS.
र॑भीयस् (VS.) or र॑भ्यस् (RV.), mfn. more violent, very strong.
र॑भीयस् (VS.) or र॑भ्यस् (RV.), mfn. more violent, very strong.
रभू m. (nom. उस्) a messenger, L.
रभो-दा॑ mfn. (fr. रभस् + दा) bestowing strength or force, RV.
राभसिक mfn. (fr. रभस्) impetuous, vehement (= आयःशूलिक, q.v.), L.
राभसिक—ता f. vehemency, impetuosity, Kād.
राभस्य n. (fr. रभस) velocity, impetuosity, Dhātup.
delight, joy, pleasure, MW.
